method.cold: new browser context and Worker; OS and driver shader caches are uncontrolled
method.reuse: same Worker/runtime; each request creates/releases its session and tensors
method.memory: sample dedicated browser RSS and main JS heap once per second during repeat; observed maxima, not guaranteed peaks
method.idleSleep: caffeinate -i only while this measurement process is alive
method.gpuCompletion: await CPU output readback before stopping the inference timer
method.display: real demo 3D on/off; a trusted camera drag during the repeated inference triggers real demand frames
